plugin.name: x11-settings
plugin._long: Tells X11 programs about the screen with the menu bar and dock: it becomes their primary screen, so that games open there and offer its resolutions, and its scale may set their Xft.dpi.

option.name: primary_screen
option._long: Off leaves X11 without a primary screen.

option.name: dpi
option._short: Xft.dpi from the main screen's scale
option._long: For X11 programs drawn at the screen's own pixels (workarounds/force_xwayland_scaling): 96 times the main screen's scale.
